_comment: Maintenance correction after the published v0.9.0 GitHub Release was left without assets when immutable-release protection rejected uploads to the already-published release.
This exact v0.9.1 scope requires the release publisher to stage and digest-verify the complete candidate-bound asset inventory on a draft before publishing the GitHub Release.
The v0.9.0 tag and immutable release are not reused. This patch changes release-integrity orchestration and makes no claim of new package product capability.

Issue #1042 is the release correction story. Required implementation task #1043 must be completed and closed before Checkpoint B can authorize publication; successful v0.9.1 publication completes the story.

required_items.summary: Create or resume GitHub Releases as drafts, verify every candidate asset before publication, and fail closed for incomplete published immutable releases
